usage: 星期一 is used to refer to the first day of the week, Monday.
You can use 星期一 to specify a day when talking about schedules or plans.
星期一 can appear as the subject or object in a sentence.
It usually comes after time words like 'this' or 'next' to indicate a particular Monday, e.g., 下星期一 next Monday.
星期一 can be combined with verbs to express activities happening on Monday.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 sing1 kei4 jat1 jiu3 faan1 gung1.
examples.meaning: I have to work on Monday.
